spans.text: POASON PWUNG EN KAWEID TOHN WEIN SAMPA KAROS duen eh dehde mehlel ong karos me tepin keirda, me aramas karos oh wein sampa karos uhdahn pahn ahniki oh ehu ansou ma korusie oh songen spwihn en aramas akan pahn tamataman ansou karos poason wet oh ngoangki de sukuhlki ong karos kekeirdahn sohng en pwung oh saledek pwukat ni irair en keirda, nan wehi kan oh nan pwungen wehikan, pwehn kak alehdt petehk parail rehn karos me towehda pwihn wet oh rehn irail tohn Kahn Sapwen Kohwa kan me mi pahn arail epwel oh manaman.
